parameters.name: Broken
parameters.units: grain count / observed image fraction; official basis is weight
parameters.notes: Length-vs-whole-kernel estimator; undetermined for N<=2. External real broken-grain labels are a candidate, not yet inspected locally.

parameters.name: Damaged
parameters.units: prediction label; observed image count fraction
parameters.notes: VGG-19 demo checkpoint has only normal/damaged classes and is uncalibrated; not validated on real rice.

parameters.name: Discoloured
parameters.notes: CIE76 LAB difference from sample reference; no real labeled evaluation.

parameters.name: Chalky
parameters.dataset: IIT Indore 2022 and Roboflow 224-image datasets are external candidates; local labels not audited
parameters.notes: Legacy synthetic-feature model disabled. Current result is Undetermined.

parameters.name: Red Grain
parameters.units: red-pixel area fraction; grain count fraction
parameters.notes: LAB/HSV visual proxy; implemented 15% area threshold is an unvalidated engineering threshold.

parameters.name: Dehusked
parameters.notes: Visual proxy is not equivalent to official chemical staining.

parameters.name: Immature / Shrunken / Shriveled
parameters.dataset: graindet_rice_v2 (external, not downloaded; unripe and fusarium/shriveled candidates)
parameters.notes: Current relative geometry rules are not trained or validated against labels.

parameters.name: Sprouted / Weevilled
parameters.dataset: synthetic_demonstration_crops_only; GrainDet-Rice has sprouted and pest-attacked classes but is external
parameters.units: prediction label and uncalibrated class score
parameters.notes: Synthetic ResNet-18 checkpoint. GrainDet's pest-attacked class is not confirmed to mean weevilled.

parameters.name: Foreign Matter
parameters.units: object count / image area estimate; official basis is weight
parameters.notes: YOLO weights unavailable; contour/color fallback active. Candidate has one foreign_object class but source groups are unknown.

parameters.name: Admixture of Lower Class Grains
parameters.units: not reported as admixture; separate geometry outlier diagnostic only
parameters.notes: A generic Mahalanobis outlier is not evidence of lower-class grain. Lower-class labels/definition are unavailable.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.dataset: GrainSet Rice (external, not downloaded; masks and physical measurement metadata described)
parameters.units: pixels unless calibrated; millimeters only with a valid scale
parameters.notes: Major-axis image measurement; accuracy against physical measurement has not been evaluated locally.

parameters.name: Breadth
parameters.dataset: GrainSet Rice (external, not downloaded; masks and physical measurement metadata described)
parameters.units: pixels unless calibrated; millimeters only with a valid scale
parameters.notes: Minor-axis image measurement; accuracy against physical measurement has not been evaluated locally.

parameters.name: L/B Ratio
parameters.dataset: GrainSet Rice (external, not downloaded; masks and physical measurement metadata described)
parameters.notes: Derived from pixel length and breadth; requires geometry validation for physical accuracy.

parameters.name: Total Count
parameters.dataset: GrainSet Rice (external, not downloaded; single-kernel masks described)
parameters.notes: Count after the existing rice gate and segmentation path; keep foreign objects separate.
